custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the three spaces.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • "Description is a required field" shows under Description, with no message under Part Number.
  • The window stays open and nothing is saved.

Step 7:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 8:

  • Part Number holds the three spaces.

Step 9:

  • "Part number is a required field" shows under Part Number, and the Description message has gone.
  • Nothing is saved.

Step 10:

  • The window closes.

Step 11:

  • No row is listed for part A: nothing was saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-N1: “Description is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Description is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • S7-N2: “Part Number is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Part number is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Description field empty or only spaces | "Description is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part Number field empty or only spaces | "Part number is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
